hero.lead: A nation of 28.5 million with oil and gas rents of 11.7% of GDP, forest across half its land and eight tenths of its power renewable, where the IMF projects growth of 5.0% this year.

capital.heading: Oil beneath, and capital still to be drawn.

record.text: Remittances received from citizens abroad, share of GDP, 2025

assets.heading: Five assets no balance sheet counts.

items.name: The Oil and Gas
items.label: Of GDP from oil and gas rents, 2014
items.text: Oil and gas already earn; the task is to turn the rent into assets that outlast it.

items.name: The Forest
items.label: Of the land under forest, 2024
items.text: Standing forest that stores carbon and water, and can earn as it stands.

items.name: The Clean Grid
items.label: Of electricity from renewable sources, 2021
items.text: Power from water, wind and sun already flows; every new connection can be clean.

items.name: The Fresh Water
items.label: Renewable fresh water a person, 2022
items.text: Rain and rivers renewed every year: power, irrigation and drinking water.

items.name: The People
items.label: Citizens, 2025
items.text: 24.9% are under fifteen: the workforce and the market of the next generation.
